settings.title: Where we deliver
settings.body: • We deliver all over Pakistan. We do not ship outside Pakistan.

settings.title: How long it takes
settings.body:
• We process your order within 24 hours.
  • Delivery takes 3 to 4 working days (Monday to Friday).
  • Delivery to remote areas may take longer.
  • Public holidays and bad weather can cause delays.

settings.title: Shipping charges
settings.body:
• Orders under Rs. 6,000: Rs. 250 shipping fee.
  • Orders of Rs. 6,000 and above: FREE shipping.
  • You will see the exact amount at checkout before you pay.

settings.title: Payment methods
settings.body:
• Cash on Delivery: pay cash when your parcel arrives. No extra COD fee.
  • Bank transfer, Easypaisa, or JazzCash.
  • We may call or WhatsApp you to confirm your order before we send it.

settings.title: Tracking
settings.body: • When your order ships, we send you a tracking number by email or WhatsApp.

settings.title: 7-day exchange
settings.body:
• Size or colour exchange within 7 days of delivery. Item must be unworn, unwashed, and have tags on.
  • One exchange per order, and only if in stock. Sale items cannot be exchanged.
  • For size or colour exchanges, you pay the courier charge to return the item. We send the new item.
  • Wrong, damaged, or faulty: WhatsApp us within 48 hours with clear photos and an unboxing video. We send a replacement and cover the return shipping.
  • We do not offer refunds. Full rules: Exchange Policy and Shipping Policy.

settings.title: Contact us
settings.body: • Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 12:00 AM (Pakistan time)
